spans.s:
Rakṣitṛ, ‘protector,’ ‘guardian,’ occurs in the Rigveda^1 and
later,^2 usually in a metaphorical sense.
1) i. 89, 1. 5; ii. 39, 6; guardian of
Soma, vi. 7, 7; of the dogs of Yama,
x. 14, 11, etc.
2) Av. iii. 27, 1; xii. 3, 55; xix. 15, 3;
Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, xiii. 4, 2, 5, etc.

Rākā in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 denotes the full moon day
as a personification. Cf.
